values.meaning: bonus magic on-hit damage at 0% target missing health
values.binNote: Bin only stores the level 1 (5) and level 18 (40) endpoints; intermediate levels here are linearly interpolated to match the wiki's pplevel scaling, matching LockePassive#MinOnHitDamage's base+0.1xAP form.

mechanics.claim: The passive damage is a bonus magic on-hit effect applied by basic attacks.
mechanics.quote: '''Locke's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{pplevel|5 to 40|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}

mechanics.claim: The on-hit damage scales up with the target's missing health, from the base amount at 0% missing health up to double at 70%+ missing health (10 to 80 base, +20% AP).
mechanics.quote: increased by {{pp|key=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100|0 to 70 by 5|key1=%|formula=7.14% for every 5% target's missing health, with the maximum at 70% target's missing health|color=health}}, up to {{pplevel|5*2 to 40*2|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}
